title: Role-Based Access Control
description: Build a role-based access control system with JWT tokens that include role claims and middleware that enforces role permissions.

steps.title: Login with role claim
steps.description: Create a POST /auth/login endpoint that validates credentials and returns a JWT token containing a 'role' claim in the payload.
hints: Accept username and password in the request body
Look up the user's role (e.g., 'admin' or 'user')
Include the role in the JWT payload during token creation

steps.title: Admin-only endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /admin endpoint that returns 200 with admin data for users with the 'admin' role and 403 Forbidden for users with the 'user' role.
hints: Verify the JWT token from the Authorization header
Extract the 'role' claim from the decoded payload

steps.title: Role-checking middleware
steps.description: Refactor the role-checking logic into a reusable `requireRole` middleware function that takes allowed roles and returns a middleware.
hints: Create a function: requireRole(...roles) => (req, res, next) => { ... }
It should first verify the token, then check if the user's role is in the allowed list
Return 401 for invalid/missing token, 403 for wrong role

steps.title: User profile endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /user/profile endpoint accessible to users with the 'user' role. Test that both admin and user roles can access different endpoints correctly.
hints: Use the requireRole middleware with appropriate roles
The /user/profile endpoint should allow both 'admin' and 'user' roles
Return the user's info from the decoded token
